newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN ALDARIS LAUNCHES MINERAL WATER.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN ALDARIS LAUNCHES MINERAL WATER.

text.p: Aldaris, the leading Latvian brewery, launched a mineral-water production line with a capacity of 70 to 90 million litres per year, Diena newspaper said on Wednesday.

Aldaris, majority-owned by Baltic Beverages Holding (BBH), will provide its BBH partners in Estonia, Lithuania and Ukraine with the Vichy Classique mineral water, the company's general manager Vitalii Gavrilov was quoted as saying.
Vichy Classique was earlier available in 0.33 litre glass bottles, while the new production line can handle 1.5 and 0.5 litre plastic bottles, the newspaper reported.
